questions.question: The edit is applied, but no shell command can run on this host: bash refuses because the sandbox can't create a namespace, so `od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6` (and any test command) is impossible from here. How should I close the verification item?

options.label: You turn off `[sandbox] bash` (setting sandbox.bash), I retry the `od` command
options.description: Guarded setting — only you can change it. Gives you the exact byte dump you asked for, though `od` is not a host-recognized verifier.

options.label: Accept the file-level check I already have
options.description: read_file confirms line 6 is retries=3 and line 7 is timeout=30, with backoff=2 and user_agent unchanged; I record it as a manual check.

options.label: Leave it unverified
options.description: Keep the edit, note explicitly that no verification ran.
